usedFor: Facebook Lead Ads captures your leads, and Google Drive keeps the files. When “New Lead Submitted” fires in Facebook Lead Ads, “Create a new sheet or doc or slide” in Google Drive can start a file for it.

bestTemplate.name: “New Lead Submitted” in Facebook Lead Ads, then “Create a new sheet or doc or slide” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: It creates a doc, sheet or slide for each lead and can save it to a chosen folder, which makes it the most useful of the three. “Create Folder” only makes an empty folder.

watchOut: “Share File With Anyone” in this pair opens a file to anyone with the link. Keep it away from lead documents, since they hold people's details.
